thread:
emma: FYI agency CTG pilot just surfaced a hard requirement: agency wants client cert chain signed by their internal CA (no public CA allowed), SAML IdP, BYOK/HSM for key custody, and a committed throughput pricing option for board approval. Need quick alignment.

jiang: SE note — we can host a private control plane in the agency VPC and terminate mTLS there. Need to confirm they27ll accept our control-plane topology and their CA chain format. Also flagged FIPS requirement for crypto.

carter: I hacked a tiny nginx sidecar to present an agency-supplied cert to the gateway. Snippet: ```
server {
  listen 443 ssl;
  ssl_certificate /opt/ctg/client.pem;
  ssl_certificate_key /opt/ctg/client.key;
  proxy_pass https://redwood-internal:8443;
}
``` I27ll push this to the POC repo with a README.

rebecca: Legal note — their security questionnaire demands explicit key custody controls (Q12). They expect BYOK with HSM attestations and audit logs export. We need contracts to include key custody and indemnity language. Pinged Contracts for a short addendum.

security-bot: SEC CHECK: IL4 constraints detected; zero-egress runtime required, KMS BYO required, FIPS-validated crypto for keys in transit and at rest. New ticket SEC-883 created.

emma: GTM request 2D they want two pricing scenarios for the steering committee next week: (A) 6-month reserved throughput (500k tokens/day) with a committed discount and SLA, (B) PAYG with burst capacity. Finance please prepare a delta and recommended commitment minimum.

finance: Works for me. Need concurrency and avg tokens/session to run the model. Please confirm numbers. ETA Fri COB for draft numbers.

jiang: Ops question: if we enable zero-egress on runtime subnets, we lose some telemetry. We should document degraded monitoring and alternative alerting (log push via secure relay).

carter: I27ll write the cert rotation runbook and demo the proxy on Thu 10:00 PT. Will include sample systemd unit and cron rotation.

rebecca: I need the completed Q12 answers by Thu 9:00 so Legal can prep the addendum before the steering deck.

emma: Proposed internal alignment sync Wed 16:00 PT to finalize diagram, runbook, and pricing before the customer steering. Can everyone confirm availability?

jiang: Confirmed.

carter: Confirmed.

finance: Confirmed; will bring draft committed vs burst numbers.

rebecca: Confirmed. I27ll drop legal27s Q12 responses in the POC folder by Thu AM.

security-bot: Reminder: Attach KMS attestation, network diagram, and cert policy to SEC-883 ticket.
